t: A pocket ESP32 gadget with a color screen, sensors and a battery inside.
steps: Look for leftover stock at maker stores such as The Pi Hut, RobotShop or Switch Science.
Install the USB driver from the M5Stack docs page on Windows or macOS.
Open the UiFlow web editor and follow the M5Stack guide to connect the stick.
Try the first example that shows text on the screen.
Learn the power trick. Hold the left button for six seconds to switch it off on battery.
Move to the Arduino IDE with the M5Unified library for bigger projects.
Plug a sensor into the side port and show its readings on the screen.
meta: Open Board. From $19.95. A few stores.
